On the table, a tablet or phone lies flat, decorated with various colorful stickers. (2) The scene transitions to the same woman now sitting on a white stool against a minimalist background that is half white and half bright yellow. She is wearing a dark blue denim long-sleeved shirt and smiling warmly towards the camera. The setting is clean and studio-like, with professional lighting creating a soft, even look.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我最近最驚訝的發現. (2) [Subtitle]: 如果早的話. (3) [Subtitle]: 35歲之後的女性. (4) [Subtitle]: 就可能開始經歷. (5) [Variety]: Perimenopause. [Subtitle]: 更年期前期的症狀. (6) [Subtitle]: 人家覺得你更年期就是. (7) [Subtitle]: 情緒化啦. (8) [Subtitle]: 精神不穩定啦. (9) [Subtitle]: 導致大家就是對於這件事情. (10) [Subtitle]: 羞於啟齒. (11) [Subtitle]: 更年期前期也就是更年期的過渡期. (12) [Subtitle]: 可以長達10年. (13) [Subtitle]: 心算一下我現在38歲. (14) [Subtitle]: 再過10年就開始更年期了. (15) [Subtitle]: 30歲的後半. (16) [Subtitle]: 就可以開始去檢查. (17) [Subtitle]: 自己荷爾蒙的量了. (18) [Subtitle]: 當你雌激素減少又開始有那些. (19) [Subtitle]: 不明確的症狀. (20) [Subtitle]: 就開始治療吧. (21) [Subtitle]: 我覺得沒有什麼不好 大家不要去排斥. (22) [Subtitle]: 就覺得為什麼30幾歲要做這件事情. (23) [Subtitle]: 早知道早治療. (24) [Slogan]: 完整影片請到 \理科太太YouTube頻道/ 觀看.
